_comment: Revenue-weighted segment look-through for multi-segment issuers (design home/v005, scripts/lib/market_risk/lookthrough.py issuer_segments_for). OPERATOR-OWNED WEIGHTS: an agent may propose an entry with status PROPOSED; only status APPROVED is ever used in a number. Ships empty: the operator approves the weights later.

<TICKER>.name: issuer name

segments.group: sector or theme key from config/market_risk_policy.yaml sectors (e.g. industrials, comm, ai_basket)

<TICKER>.source: filing, section and period the weights come from

_schema._rules: Sector-kind weights sum to 1.0 within 0.01; theme weights (ai_basket, semis) are extra and overlap a sector. Stale after issuer_segments.stale_after_days in config/market_risk_policy.yaml.
